# Rectangular Filled Composite Column (AISC DG6)

```{python}
#| label: composite-inputs
from design.composite_column_designer_aiscDG06 import RectangularFilledComposite

# ------------------------- INPUTS (edit here) -------------------------
column = RectangularFilledComposite(
    label="Column C1",
    # geometry & materials
    b_mm=635.0, h_mm=635.0, t_mm=12.7,
    fc_mpa=41.37, fy_mpa=344.74,
    Lb_m=9.144, Lh_m=9.144,          # unbraced lengths (b-axis / h-axis)
    # demands (LRFD)
    Pu_kN=6672.3,
    Mb_kNm=2440.5, Mh_kNm=0.0,
    Vbx_kN=400.3, Vhy_kN=0.0,
    # optional
    Asr_mm2=0.0, Fysr_mpa=414.0, ri_mm=0.0, shear_span_to_depth=None,
)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{python}
#| label: composite-report
#| output: asis
print(column.report(heading_level=2))
```
